description: A disclosure: a trigger that shows and hides a region of content. Open or closed is a prop a consumer sets, not an interaction state.

notes: The trigger is a real <button>; aria-expanded is the state, aria-controls the relationship (4.1.2).
Closed content is hidden from everyone, not only visually (1.3.1).

decisions.question: Scaffolded as accordion (named "Collapsible"). Confirm, or re-run npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=collapsible --archetype=<link-card|card|collection>.
alternatives: link-card: A card that is one link: illustration or icon, a headline, optional description, an arrow affordance. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name.
card: A non-interactive content card; actions live in a slot.
collection: A row, grid or scroller of one repeated unit.
button: Triggers an action. A label, optional leading and trailing icons, and the full interactive state set.
checkbox / radio: A selection control with a checked state, usually paired with a label.
toggle / switch: A binary on/off control that applies immediately.
input / field: Accepts typed input. Label, value, placeholder, and an error state.
badge / tag / chip: A small label. Non-interactive unless it is dismissible.
pagination: Moves between pages of content.
select / dropdown: A choice among options. The native <select> does the choosing; the design styles the trigger around it.
helper text: Guidance or a message under a field: hint, error, success. Associated with its field, never floating.
list: A sequence of like items — features, links, steps. The items are the content; the list is the rhythm.
decisions.evidence: decided by heuristic; token namespaces content×1; state axis open/closed

decisions.question: control-button, s2-icon-chevron-down-20-n have no class of their own in collapsible.css. The design names these parts separately and the code does not. Split the class, or model them as one part.
decisions.chose: kept a derived selector that matches nothing
decisions.fix: Set anatomy.root.parts.<part>.selector to the real class, or add the class to collapsible.css.

decisions.question: Structural match says extend: closest existing contract is ControlButton (score 1). Extend it instead of adding a component?
decisions.chose: a new component, over extending ControlButton (match extend, score 1)
decisions.fix: If it is the same component, delete this draft and add a variant to ControlButton instead.
decisions.evidence: ControlButton (1) already covers this; extend it.

decisions.question: label exist in the component but have no design counterpart. Confirm each is authored (lever true) or integration-only (lever false).
decisions.chose: added 1 code-only prop as levers with no design binding
decisions.fix: Set lever:false on the integration-only ones, or delete any the component should stop accepting.

decisions.question: "State" (open|closed) read as the boolean prop "open", not as runtime states — a consumer sets it; the design's open is true. Confirm, or change it in props/states.
decisions.chose: "State" (open|closed) read as the boolean prop "open", not as runtime states — a consumer sets it; the design's open is true
decisions.fix: Edit props[] or states[] in this file.

decisions.question: Built from 2 component sets, all of which already have a contract: ControlButton ×2, TextCard. Confirm the anatomy models them as slots or parts deliberately.
decisions.chose: recorded 2 composed sets, 2 already contracted; 2 icon sets left for the icon slot
decisions.decision: All composed sets are contracted; anatomy models them deliberately.

decisions.question: 1 layers carry Figma-generated names (/.trigger/S2_Icon_ChevronDown_20_N/Frame). Build set from this contract produces the normalized set (.root, .part names); replace the frame with it once reviewed.
decisions.fix: Run Build set from this contract, then re-anchor anchors.figma.nodeId to the normalized set.

decisions.question: The design fills the "s2-icon-chevron-down-20-n" slot with S2_Icon_ChevronDown_20_N. The contract records the design's choice; binding it to the code icon library (packages/components/src/icons, manifest s2a-icons) is a decision — Heal in the Contract Book makes it when the names match, or set slot.default.manifest and slot.default.icon by hand.
decisions.chose: recorded the design's default instance; left the library binding open
decisions.fix: Set anatomy.root.parts.<part>.slot.default to { "manifest": "s2a-icons", "icon": "<name>" }; add the SVG to packages/components/src/icons if it is missing, then npm run specs:assets.

decisions.question: The set draws the component at a fixed width on its page. Is that the component's width, or the frame it was drawn in?
decisions.chose: the container's: width 100%. A component's width belongs to where it is placed; the design's number is the artboard.
decisions.fix: If this component really has an intrinsic width, set anatomy.root.tokens.width to it.

decisions.question: 4 values in the design are set with no variable behind them: root width = 100%; root/trigger height@style=default = 20px; root/trigger/s2-icon-chevron-down-20-n width = 20px; root/trigger/s2-icon-chevron-down-20-n height = 20px. A literal in a contract is a token gap: bind the property to an S2A variable in Figma and re-extract, or keep the raw: value and record why here.
decisions.chose: carried them through as raw: values so the render matches the file
decisions.fix: In Figma, bind the layer's property to an S2A variable, then re-extract; or replace the raw: with a {s2a.…} token that resolves to the same value.

decisions.question: The design binds s2a/typography/line-height/title-6 and the built token CSS does not ship it. Carry the literal until it does?
decisions.chose: {s2a.typography.line-height.title-6} → raw:18px, the value the design resolves to. A token-pipeline gap: when s2a/typography/line-height/title-6 ships, replace the literal with {s2a.typography.line-height.title-6}.
decisions.decision: {s2a.typography.line-height.title-6} → raw:18px, the value the design resolves to. A token-pipeline gap: when s2a/typography/line-height/title-6 ships, replace the literal with {s2a.typography.line-height.title-6}.
